info.title: API.SH: Y Combinator
info.description: The Y Combinator API from API.SH: public Y Combinator data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Search the YC startup directory with every filter the site offers: batch, industry, sub-industry, tags, region, status, team size, hiring now, nonprofit, top company and launch date. Each company: id, name, slug, link, one-liner, description, website, logo, batch, status, stage, industry, sub-industry, industries, tags, regions, locations, team size, launch date, hiring, top company and nonprofit flags, former names. Up to 1,000 results per filter set (narrow the filters to reach more). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page. Filter values with counts: `/ycombinator/v1/filters`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ycombinator-companies

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free-text search over names, one-liners and descriptions, e.g. `developer tools`.

parameters.name: batch
parameters.description: One or more batches, comma-separated: `W24`, `S21`, `F25`, `X25` (Spring) or `Winter 2024`.

parameters.name: industry
parameters.description: Industry or sub-industry name as the site lists it, e.g. `B2B`, `Fintech`, `Healthcare`, `Consumer`, `Developer Tools` (comma-separated for any of several).

parameters.name: subindustry
parameters.description: Sub-industry path as the site lists it, e.g. `B2B -> Engineering, Product and Design`.

parameters.name: regions
parameters.description: Regions, comma-separated (any of them), e.g. `United States of America`, `Europe`, `India`, `Remote`, `Fully Remote`.

parameters.name: is_hiring
parameters.description: Only companies hiring now (`true`) or not (`false`).

parameters.name: launched_after
parameters.description: Companies that launched on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: launched_before
parameters.description: Companies that launched on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: `relevance` (default, the site's ranking) or `launch_date` (newest launches first).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One company's YC profile: name, one-liner, long description, website, batch, status, year founded, team size, location, tags, logo, LinkedIn/X/Facebook/Crunchbase/GitHub links, founders (name, title, public bio, LinkedIn and X links), the primary group partner, open jobs, recent news, Launch YC posts, photos and videos.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ycombinator-company

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Company slug (the part after ycombinator.com/companies/), e.g. `airbnb`. Give `slug` or `url`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every filter value of a YC directory with its count: for companies the batches, industries, sub-industries, tags, regions, statuses and hiring/nonprofit/top-company splits; for founders the batches, titles, industries and regions; for launches the batches, industries and tags. Use the values as filters on the matching search endpoint.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ycombinator-filters

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search the YC founders directory: name, Hacker News username, photo, current company and title, company link, all companies, YC titles, batches, industries, sub-industries, region and top-company flag. Filter by batch, title, industry, sub-industry, region and top company. Up to 1,000 results per filter set. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ycombinator-founders

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: YC title, e.g. `Founder`, `CEO`, `CTO`, `COO` (comma-separated for any of several).

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Current region, e.g. `United States of America`, `United Kingdom`, `India`.

parameters.name: top_company
parameters.description: Only founders of YC top companies (`true`).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One job at a YC startup: title, location, type, role, salary and equity, experience, visa, skills, full description, apply link, the company (with its hiring pitch, tech stack and founders) and related jobs; YC job links also carry the interview process. Give a ycombinator.com job link, a workatastartup.com/jobs/<id> link or that id (the `id` in `/ycombinator/v1/jobs` results). `latest=true` returns a current software engineering job.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ycombinator-job

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Work at a Startup job id (numeric, from `/ycombinator/v1/jobs`).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Jobs at YC startups (Work at a Startup). Either a free-text search (`q`, natural language such as `rust engineer remote` or `designer new york`; about 30 best matches) or the role and location lists (`role`, `location`: about 20-40 current jobs each). Each job: id, title, link, location, type, role, salary and equity ranges, minimum experience, visa, skills, posted and last-active times, apply link and the company (name, slug, batch, one-liner, logo).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ycombinator-jobs

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Launch YC post: title, tagline, full text (Markdown), dates, vote count, the company and the author. `latest=true` returns the newest launch.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ycombinator-launch

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Launch slug (the part after ycombinator.com/launches/). Give `slug`, `url` or `latest`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Launch YC posts, newest first or by votes: id, slug, link, title, tagline, date, vote count, the company (name, slug, website, logo, batch, industry, tags) and the author. Filter by batch, industry and tags; `body=true` adds each post's full text. Up to 1,000 results per filter set. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ycombinator-launches

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free-text search over launch titles and text.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: `true` adds each post's full text (larger response).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
